description: This file implements a WebSocket stream integration for OpenAI, managing WebSocket sessions, fallbacks to HTTP, session cleanup, warm-up procedures, and error handling. It provides a factory function to create a stream that maintains persistent WebSocket connections, with session management and fallback logic.

classes.name: LocalAssistantMessageEventStream
classes.description: A local implementation of an async message event stream, queuing events and providing an async iterator interface.

classes.name: OpenAIWebSocketRuntimeError
classes.description: Custom error class representing runtime errors during WebSocket operations, including disconnects, send errors, and server errors.

methods.name: resolveWsTransport
methods.description: Determines the WebSocket transport type ('sse', 'websocket', or 'auto') based on options.

methods.name: resolveWsWarmup
methods.description: Checks if warm-up should be performed for WebSocket connection based on options.

methods.name: resetWsSession
methods.description: Resets a WebSocket session, optionally preserving the degraded state.

methods.name: markWsSessionDegraded
methods.description: Marks a WebSocket session as degraded, setting a cooldown until reconnection attempts.

methods.name: isWsSessionDegraded
methods.description: Checks if a WebSocket session is currently in cooldown/degraded state.

methods.name: createWsManager
methods.description: Creates a new WebSocket manager with optional session headers.

methods.name: formatOpenAIWebSocketError
methods.description: Formats error details from WebSocket error events into a human-readable string.

methods.name: formatOpenAIWebSocketResponseFailure
methods.description: Formats failure responses from WebSocket responses into a string.

methods.name: buildRetryableSendError
methods.description: Creates a retryable WebSocket send error.

methods.name: runWarmUp
methods.description: Performs warm-up of WebSocket connection with optional tools and instructions.

methods.name: createOpenAIWebSocketStreamFn
methods.description: Factory function that creates a StreamFn maintaining a persistent WebSocket connection, with fallback to HTTP on failure.

methods.name: fallbackToHttp
methods.description: Falls back to HTTP streaming when WebSocket connection fails or is unavailable, piping events into the existing stream.
